bib.title: Transformers: State-of-the-Art Natural Language Processing
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 2020 EMNLP (Systems Demonstrations), pages 38-45

question: How can Transformer architectures and pretrained models be made accessible, extensible and deployable through one open-source library and a community model hub?
contributions: A library of Transformer architectures under a unified API (tokenizer, transformer, head)
A community Model Hub for distributing pretrained and fine-tuned models, with model cards and live inference
Deployment paths: PyTorch/TensorFlow interoperability, TorchScript, ONNX, CoreML

method.summary: Describes the design of the Hugging Face Transformers library: every model is a tokenizer, a transformer and a task head, loaded through Auto classes, with a hub for sharing checkpoints. No model is trained and no controlled experiment is run; one ONNX speed-up figure is reported.
method.task: software system description (library and model hub)

inference.decoding: Conditional generation heads support sampling and beam search (no settings given)

other.tokenizers: Character-level BPE (NMT, GPT), Byte-level BPE (GPT-2), WordPiece (BERT), SentencePiece (XLNet), Unigram (LM), Character (Reformer), Custom (Bio-Chem); Rust-based tokenizers library is default in latest release

metrics.name: ONNX inference speed-up
metrics.definition: not defined in text; read from Fig 4

eval.protocol: Experiments run with the ONNX team; hardware, batch size, sequence length and baseline not stated in text.

results.claim: ONNX export of BERT, RoBERTa and GPT-2 gave nearly a 4x speedup
results.setup: BERT, RoBERTa, GPT-2 from the library exported to ONNX, experiments with the ONNX team; hardware and baseline not given in text

results.claim: The Model Hub held 2,097 user models, pretrained and fine-tuned
results.setup: Model Hub at time of writing (2020)

results.claim: The library has over 400 external contributors and an Apache 2.0 licence

limits: Technical report: focuses on core modeling specification and defers training and development tooling to the documentation
The only quantitative experiment (ONNX) gives no hardware, baseline or sequence length in text; figure values are not in the text
Counts (2,097 hub models, 400 contributors) and the model list date from 2020

terms.definition: converts raw text to sparse index encodings; stores the vocabulary token-to-index map and handles encoding and decoding per the model's tokenization process; handles special tokens, token type indices and truncation to maximum length
uses contextual embeddings to make a task-specific prediction; a wrapper class adding an output layer and optional loss on top of the transformer's contextual embeddings
a unified API that instantiates the right model or tokenizer from a user-specified pretrained model configuration, allowing switching between models and frameworks

lineage.work: Attention is all you need (Vaswani et al.)

lineage.note: structure inspired by original BERT code; BERT implemented
idea of easy caching of pretrained models
